entries.zh: （东西）重得扛不起来；太重举不起
entries.en: too heavy to be lifted up; a weight that cannot be raised
entries.notes: 西/汉/音三栏互证清晰（Pesado que no se puede levantar＝重扛不起来），唯 M 栏含一处 T99（污損難辨）声调标记，按门禁计低置信

entries.zh: 心火炽盛；极其恼怒忧烦
entries.en: very great vexation; heart-fire blazing (intense anger)
entries.notes: 汉字'燡'与'燥'形近存疑（[疑]标记），M 栏第三音节中断作'n.'，取'心火炽盛'义

entries.zh: 挂碍（罣礙）：心中牵挂窒碍；妨碍、障碍
entries.en: mental impediment, obstruction (attachment hindering the mind); a vexation that hinders him
entries.notes: 首字'挂'与'掸'存疑（[疑]标记），据 M 栏 cua gay 定为'挂碍（罣礙）'

entries.zh: 可伤（可哀之事）；吊唁，向遭不幸者致哀
entries.en: lamentable, a cause of grief; to offer condolence for a misfortune (dar el pésame)

entries.zh: 称量它：称看有多重；设法称定其重
entries.en: to weigh it; to find out how much it weighs
entries.notes: 汉栏'皆称看義多'中'看/首'存疑；据 M 栏 cua xoa chey（joá-tséi 近'偌濟'＝多少）释为称看有多重，属推断，故降中置信

entries.en: to weigh with a balance; a balance, weighing instrument
to weigh out medicines; to dispense or compound medicine by weight
entries.notes: 首字'配'与'沛'存疑（[疑]标记），据 M 栏 pay yo 定'配药'，即按方分量称药

entries.en: the large (heavy) steelyard; to weigh with the big steelyard
to smelt or melt (silver) in a crucible; to mold and cast — Spanish column reads 'to weigh the silver'
entries.notes: 汉栏'鎔/錄'存疑（[疑]标记）；西栏作 pesar la plata（称银）而汉/音栏均作'陶镕'（熔铸），从汉/音栏取熔银义并注西栏差异
仅西栏存非标准西语残串 'Duuār ge kiñca, piña.'（似闽南语或他加禄语连写，piña＝菠萝），汉、音、官话三栏皆空，无从定夺

entries.zh: 恨：心中怨愤恼怒（使人怀恨）
entries.en: resentment, hatred; that which grieves or vexes one

entries.zh: 悼：哀伤悼念；为未来的祸患忧伤担忧
entries.en: to mourn, grieve; to be distressed over future misfortunes
entries.notes: 汉栏单字'悼'而 M 栏作三音节 to chim toy（后两音标注存疑），疑为释语连写，取哀悼并为将来之祸忧伤义
